ruling.author: Legal
ruling.decision: Extraordinary if no aircraft within 3 h of STD and the earliest reroute was offered
ruling.explanation: A return sector of a storm-cancelled rotation is extraordinary only if no aircraft and crew could operate it within 3 h of STD, and passengers were offered the earliest reroute on any carrier (C-74/19).
